title: ai-agent operations
description: ai-agent's two commands, reached as `zazzle agent llm|prompt` (the invoker execs `zazzle daemon llm`, which execs ai-agent) by daemon running `ai-agent prompt --no-download` as a child for an agent's `--llm`, `brief` and `prompt` (src/macos/daemon/src/llm.rs), or by running the binary directly. An error prints `error: ...` on standard error and exits 2.

entities.name: zazzle agent llm
entities.description: Lists the model catalogue; or downloads a model and makes it, and an effort, the default; or removes a downloaded model.
entities.transport: zazzle agent llm [--model NAME] [--effort low|medium|high] | --remove NAME (ai-agent llm ..)
entities.authorization: None checked: the caller's own permissions on the model directory.
entities.result: With no option, the catalogue (name, size, downloaded or not, what it is for, the default marked) with the default model, effort and model directory; with --model or --effort, `default: MODEL at effort EFFORT`; with --remove, `removed NAME` or `NAME was not downloaded`.
failures: An unknown or ambiguous model name.
An effort other than low, medium or high.
A failed or mismatching model download.
The directory or defaults file cannot be written; HOME is unset and ZAZZLE_LLM_DIR is not given.

entities.name: zazzle agent prompt
entities.description: Asks a model and streams its answer, downloading the model first when it is missing unless --no-download is given.
entities.transport: zazzle agent prompt [--model NAME] [--effort E] [--system TEXT] [--max-tokens N] [--show-thinking] [--no-download] [--grammar GBNF] [--temp T] [TEXT.. | -] (ai-agent prompt ..)
entities.authorization: None checked: the caller's own permissions.
entities.result: The answer on standard output; the thinking on standard error with --show-thinking; exit 0, or 3 with a note on standard error when the token limit cut the answer short. --grammar holds the answer to a GBNF grammar (root rule `root`); --temp sets the sampling temperature (default 0.7; 0 takes the likeliest token every time). It changes nothing but the model store, when it downloads the model.
failures: An unknown or ambiguous model name, or an unknown effort.
An empty prompt: `nothing to ask: give TEXT, or pipe it in`.
A failed or mismatching model download.
With --no-download, a model that is not downloaded: `error: NAME is not downloaded (SIZE): run `zazzle agent llm --model NAME` first`, exit 4.
A model that cannot be loaded or has no usable chat template.
A prompt as long as the model's training context or longer.

relatedViews.relationship: The use cases that call these commands.
`zazzle daemon llm`, the way in from zazzle.
zazzle's brief and prompt, which call `prompt --no-download`.
Post-processing with `--llm` and brief, which call `prompt --no-download` with --grammar and --temp.
